[[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || - || - |- | 1 || - || - |- | 2 || - || - |- | 3 || +40% || 7 |} ==Drop Locations== {{DropLocations}} ==Notes== *The additional rounds do not consume additional ammunition. *At rank 4 or higher, this mod guarantees that at least 2 rounds will be fired for every 1 round of ammunition expended. *At maximum rank, this mod grants an 100% chance to fire one additional round (2 rounds/shot) and a 20% chance to fire two additional rounds (3 rounds/shot). **Equipping this mod and {{M|Lethal Torrent}} simultaneously will provide 180% multishot, giving the sidearm a 100% chance to fire one additional round (2 rounds/shot) and an 80% chance to fire two additional rounds (3 rounds/shot). **For weapons that fire multiple pellets (i.e. a {{Weapon|Bronco}}) the pellet count is multiplied by the multishot value. ***A {{Weapon|Bronco}} with a rank 5 Barrel Diffusion will fire 7 \times (1 + 1.2) = 15.4 pellets, meaning it has a 100% chance to fire 15 pellets and a 40% chance to fire 1 extra pellet. *The in-game UI will consider any possible multishot capabilities when showing total damage numbers, and does not represent single-projectile damage. **Total damage displayed does not represent the actual damage per shot, but the expected average damage. *Equipping this mod increases the status chance of a weapon indirectly. '''Blaze''' is a [[mod]] that increases the damage and {{D|Heat}} damage for [[:Category:Shotgun|shotguns]] by 15% per rank, at a maximum of 60% at rank 3.

==Drop Locations==
Blaze drops from [[Nightmare Mode]] missions. Blaze only drops from Tier 1 (easy) missions, which are on Earth, Venus, Mercury, and Mars.{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*This mod, when combined with {{M|Point Blank}} and {{M|Vicious Spread}} adds up to a total damage increase of +240%.
**Using {{M|Primed Point Blank}} instead of Point Blank will result in a total damage increase of +315%
*This mod is more cost effective than a Rank 3 Point Blank mod and a rank 3 {{M|Incendiary Coat}} mod put together (9 mod capacity compared to 16).
*The +60% base damage will apply to the +60% heat damage, giving approximately +96% heat damage.

==Notes==
*The +120% Critical Damage buff applies '''additively''' with other Critical Damage mods. Meaning, a base 2x crit multiplier with maxed {{M|Vital Sense}}, {{M|Hammer Shot}} and Bladed Rounds will become 8.0x.
*Upon killing an enemy, a {{Stat|Critical Multiplier}} buff icon and timer will appear next to the player's health.
*For projectiles with travel time, this mod is unaffected by whether you were aiming when the shot was fired; the {{Stat|Critical Multiplier}} increase will apply as long as you are aiming when the projectile hits.

==Tips==
*This mod is ideal for use on weapons with high base critical chances, ex. {{Weapon|Soma}}, {{Weapon|Vectis}}, {{Weapon|Amprex}}, {{Weapon|Tonkor}}, etc.

{{Codex|Make easy prey of enemies with this quiet, agile, and pinpoint accurate Tenno submachine gun.}}
The '''Baza''' is a  {{Faction|Tenno}} [[Noise Level|silenced]] submachine gun with a high [[critical chance]], [[critical multiplier]], [[fire rate]] and  [[accuracy]] at the cost medium range damage falloff and a small magazine.

==Characteristics==
* This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage.
*This weapon is [[Noise Level|Silent]].
*Low [[zoom]] when aiming.
*Shorter damage falloff distance for a hit-scan weapon.
{{Advantages|
*Very high [[accuracy]] per shot, even at full auto.
*Negligible recoil.
*[[Noise Level|Silent]] nature allows for stealth usage.
*Lower zoom allows for a more stable view.}}
{{Disadvantages|
*Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% starting at 22m until 34m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]).
**Cannot equip {{M|Terminal Velocity}}.
*Poor ammo economy.
}}
{{WeaponComparison|Baza Prime}}

==Acquisition==
The Baza's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Tenno Lab|Tenno Lab]] in the [[dojo]].
{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

==Notes==
*The weapon's firing sounds increases in pitch when 15 or fewer rounds are remaining in the magazine, indicating that the weapon's magazine is almost empty.
*The weapon has minimal zoom when aiming, helpful for mods that add bonuses while aiming like {{M|Argon Scope}}.

==Tips==
*The Baza's high accuracy allows it to land headshots consistently compared to other automatic weapons, which along with its good critical hit chance makes it ideal for builds using {{M|Argon Scope}}.
*Its lower [[status chance]] compared to some other automatic rifles can be alleviated with the {{M|Hunter Munitions}} mod, allowing the weapon to spread {{D|Slash}} procs rapidly to enemies, which helps the weapon a lot versus heavy armor.
*Its silenced nature makes it synergize well with {{WF|Ivara}}, as firing the weapon will not interrupt her {{A|Prowl}} ability.
*Since the Baza has very high accuracy, it can use [[Heavy Caliber]] with almost no drawback and increasing the weapon's overall damage output.

==Trivia==
*The ''[[wikipedia:Aviceda|Baza]]'' are a genus of bird of prey in the Accipitridae family.
*Physically, the weapon bears a strong resemblance to the real-life [[wikipedia:PP-19_Bizon|PP-19 Bizon]] SMG, due to Baza's underbarrel, horizontal magazine, and its overall appearance.
**The name Baza may be derived from the PP-19's nickname, Bizon.
*The name Baza (shortening of "Barry") is strongly believe to be derived from a conversation had at PAX Aus between DE staff and fans, where "Australian Names" were discussed. It was claimed that "Baza" may be the "most Australian name".  There was also discussion about many great names from native flora and fauna (released with the {{Weapon|Cassowar}}).
*Tied with {{Weapon|Soma}}/{{Weapon|Soma Prime}}, {{Weapon|Attica}}, and {{Weapon|Baza Prime}} for the highest [[critical multiplier]] of all fully automatic rifles.
*Second fastest [[reload speed]] of all fully automatic rifles, behind {{Weapon|Baza Prime}}.
*Tied with {{Weapon|Baza Prime}} for the third fastest [[fire rate]] of all fully automatic rifles, behind {{Weapon|Grakata}} and {{Weapon|Prisma Grakata}}.
*Tied with {{Weapon|Baza Prime}} for the fourth lowest base damage of all fully automatic rifles, after {{Weapon|Prisma Grakata}}, {{Weapon|Soma}}/{{Weapon|Soma Prime}}, and {{Weapon|Grakata}}; very reliant on its high critical damage potential.

{{Top|Enemy|Corpus|Corpus|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|A weapon that builds charge the more it kills. Hit capacity then release for an obliterating discharge of power.}} The '''Battacor''' is a {{Faction|Corpus}} burst rifle incorporating {{Faction|Sentient}} technology. Its primary fire shoots fully automatic 2-round bursts and builds charges on kills that powers up its [[Alternate Fire]], an obliterating laser. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Magnetic}} damage on its primary fire and {{D|Radiation}} damage on its alt-fire. *Primary fire is a fully automatic 2-round burst rifle. **Kills with primary fire stacks charges up to '''3''' times, increasing the damage of Alternate Fire. *[[Alternate Fire]] fires a powerful beam that explodes in a '''3.4''' meter radius upon impact with a surface or enemy. **Initial hit and explosion apply status separately. **Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. **Can benefit from {{M|Firestorm}} ({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}) and {{M|Cautious Shot}}. *Can equip the Battacor-exclusive {{M|Sentient Barrage}} mod. {{Advantages|class=Rifle|trigger=Burst|}} {{Disadvantages|class=Rifle|trigger=Burst| *Alternate Fire: **Explosion inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]]. **Explosion has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions. **Explosion has linear damage falloff from 100% to 60% from central impact. }} ==Acquisition== The Battacor's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Energy Lab|Energy Lab]] in the [[dojo]]. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== * Primary fire accumulates up to '''3''' charges when killing enemies, allowing the [[Alternate Fire]] to unleash an {{Weapon|Opticor}}-like beam that can pierce and hit multiple enemies. This also causes an explosion with the first surface or enemy impact, inflicting the same damage as the beam itself. All charges are used up when the beam fires. ** Initial hit and explosion apply status separately. ** Charges can only be gained through kills made by the primary fire, or damage from status effects caused by the primary fire. ** Shots explode in a '''3.4''' meter radius on impact with an enemy. ** Shots explode in a '''6''' meter radius on impact with a surface. *** Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. *** Explosion has linear damage falloff from 100% to 60% from central impact. ** Beam has a width of 0.5 meters. ** Charge is automatic and does not need to be held down. ** Damage multiplier of the charges is equal to the amount of charges stored (e.g. 3 charges does 3x damage). ** Alt-fire cannot be used without any charges. ** Charge status is indicated by a trio of horizontal bars on the right side of the crosshairs. ** Charge can be cancelled by pressing the alternate fire button again. == Known Bugs == * {{M|Galvanized Aptitude}} is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits from primary fire. * Multishot has no effect on the radial damage of the altfire. ==Trivia== *The Battacor is the first non-Archwing weapon in-game to use the Auto Burst trigger, with the [[Cyngas]] being the first overall. *A Battacor can be seen being tested in a Corpus firing range in the Enrichment Labs area of [[Orb Vallis]], where [[Conculyst]]s are also being researched on. *Though Battacor is a primary firearm, there is a ring that looks similar to [[Jai#Jai|Jai]] Link attached to it. This aesthetic is shared with {{Weapon|Ocucor}}. *The Battacor's name, like the Ocucor, seems to be a portmanteau, incorporating [[Battalyst]] (a Sentient enemy) and the suffix ''-cor'', seen in some other Corpus weapons. Also in line with the Ocucor appearing to be a modified Amp prism, the Battacor appears to be a modified Battalyst arm. *A hologram of the Battacor can be seen in the Reworked Corpus Ship tileset in a room where a Solaris prisoner can sometimes be found. ==Media== Corpus-Rifle-(Battacor).jpg|Official image from the Fortuna website Sentient-Corpus Weapins (2).png|Battacor Model Concept File:Nikita-leshakov-battacor-lowpoly.jpg File:Nikita-leshakov-battacor-highpoly.jpg File:Warframe.x64 2019-03-25 14-31-54.png|Corpus testing the Battacor File:Warframe.x64 2019-03-25 14-32-17.png|Battacor test in action File:Lucas-hug-crpsenthybrid1.jpg|Concept art File:Screenshot 494.png|Battacor in the Arsenal File:Screenshot 493.png {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|uuSoGrvlpbM|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|OAb2TU3c-as|size=300px}} }} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|38.5}} *Fixed Battacor’s Sentient Barrage alt fire discharge automatically queuing a second shot that does not track enemies hit correctly when the “Fire Manual Trigger Weapons Continuously" toggle is enabled. {{ver|33}} *Fixed Battacor requiring all 3 charges to use its alt fire instead of the intended 1 or 2 charges to scale the damage. {{ver|32.3.1}} *Fixed Crash from using the alt-fire on the Battacor with any number of charges accumulated. **Temporarily, the Battacor will require all 3 charges to use its alternate fire mode. This will be restored in a later update to the original behavior {{ver|32.2.1}} *Fixed the Battacor’s alt-fire causing self damage instead of self stagger. **Lua’s Prey was a mainline update, which meant some things could slip through the cracks - this just happened to be one of them. As mentioned in Devstream #166, self damage changes will be released at a later date. {{ver|32}} ;Headshot Damage Changes During playtesting, the ammo changes alone weren’t enough to significantly change things for AoE weapons. So instead of tightening these values to be overly restrictive, we chose to address other factors that make these weapons so strong, such as headshot damage. Our approach here is two-fold, to reduce the impact of headshots for AOE weapons, but to also make precision headshots pack a larger punch overall. *Radial damage no longer gains extra headshot damage or triggers headshot conditions. **This is primarily targeted at the Ignis Wraith - as a “flamethrower” weapon, it’s hard to imagine a blanket of elements being precise enough to target weak points specifically. Explosive projectiles themselves can still land headshots, so there is still a reason to aim with most weapons for maximum damage. {{ver|29.2}} *Fixed Battacor's Alt Fire damage being the same whether fired with 1 charge or 3. {{ver|29}} *(Undocumented) Number of Alt Fire charges reverted back to 3. {{ver|28.3}} *Fixed kills with the Battacor's Alt Fire contributing towards its charges. {{ver|28.1}} *(Undocumented) Number of Alt Fire charges increased to 5. {{ver|28.0.3}} *Fixed the Battacor having unlimited usage of Alt Fire. {{ver|27.2.2}}
Reduced the following AoE weapons Radial Damage Falloff from central impact that were all previously 90%: *Battacor: 40% {{ver|27.2}} ;Self Damage Changes: We are getting rid of Self Damage and replacing it with something else: instead of Self Damage, it’s now ‘Stagger’. This change completely removes the chance of killing yourself, and instead now creates scenarios where you will interrupt yourself - or ‘Stagger’ - to varying degrees if you aren’t careful. The degrees of Self-Interrupt start with a small stumble all the way to full knockdown depending on how close you are to the center of explosion. Any Mods referring to Self Damage will be converted to acknowledge Stagger. With this Self-Interrupt system, we have added dozens of new recovery animations that harness a ninja-like recovery experience. By pressing ‘Jump’ at the correct time, you can execute a ninja-skill-based knockdown recovery to ALL in-game knockdowns. This ninja recovery window is indicated by a glowing FX on your Warframe. In addition to Self Damage being removed, some of the more powerful AOE weapons without Self Damage presently will have the Stagger added, but it should only be noticeable in cases of extreme inaccuracy on the player’s part. The Weapons include: *Battacor In the original Dev Workshop, we said:
''As a result of this overall systemic change, Weapons with Stagger will be getting approximately a 20% buff in Damage, with any weapons with AOE receiving a 50% Radial Damage Falloff from central impact.'' This is no longer accurate after continued testing. What we are doing now is: No damage buffs have been added, but any weapons with AOE are receiving ~20% increase in Radius. Additionally, AOE weapons are receiving a 90% Radial Damage Falloff from central impact. This means on the very outer section of the explosion Radius 10% of the Damage will be dealt. Tactics will be deadly - aim true, Tenno. ''Why: Several players brought up the history of the Tonkor and we want to make sure we ship this change in a place that’s conservative in its starting point from a balance perspective. The complete removal of Self Damage does change the pace of destruction with some of the game’s most powerful weapons, so we want to make sure we can iterate upwardly instead of releasing a bonanza of explosions with no other choices.'' {{ver|24.2}} *Reduced the delay until you can use the primary fire after using secondary fire. {{ver|24.0.5}} *Reduced the Fieldron crafting requirements for the Kreska, Ocucor, and Battacor from 20 to 10.﻿﻿ {{ver|24}} *Introduced. }} {{ver/Lu|24.0.5}} ==See Also== *{{Weapon|Ocucor}}, the secondary counterpart to this weapon. *{{Weapon|Kreska}}, the melee counterpart to this weapon. {{ResearchNav}} {{WeaponNav}} [[de:Battacor]] [[es:Battacor]] [[fr:Battacor]] [[Category:Update 24]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Corpus Weapons]] [[Category:Sentient]] [[Category:Corpus]] [[Category:Burst Fire]] [[Category:Radiation Damage Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons with Alt Fire]] [[Category:Sentient Weapons]] [[Category:Augmented Weapons]] [[uk:Баттакор]]

{{Top|Enemy|Sentient|Sentient|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|This Sentient war instrument can either barrage targets with explosive bolts, or, draw on its regenerative battery to create twin plasma beams that chain through targets. When fully drained, Health is leached from nearby foes for a short period.}} The '''Basmu''' is a {{Faction|Sentient}} rifle that fires {{D|Electricity}} rounds that create {{D|Heat}} damage explosions on impact. The [[Alternate Fire]] channels two beams of {{D|Electricity}} that conducts between targets, with its extreme [[critical multiplier]] offset by its low [[critical chance]]. When fully expending the battery, the rifle releases multiple energy pulses, staggering enemies and leeching health from them. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals {{D|Electricity}} damage, and the explosion deals {{D|Heat}} damage. *Primary fire shoots rounds that explodes '''1.7''' meter radius upon impact with a surface or enemy. **Initial hit and explosion apply status separately. **Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. **Explosions can benefit from {{M|Firestorm}} ({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}) and {{M|Cautious Shot}}. *[[Alternate Fire]] shoots two continuous '''9''' meter beams that lock onto enemies within '''30°''' of the reticle. Each beam can chain up to '''5''' nearby enemies within '''7''' meters from the initial target, with each chain dealing '''50%''' of the previous chain's damage. **{{M|Heavy Caliber}}'s accuracy penalty on Alternate Fire is minimal. *Fully depleting the battery produces three '''10''' meter pulses that deals up to '''10''' {{D|True}} damage, staggers nearby enemies and heals the user's health by '''10x''' the damage done to each enemy per pulse. *This weapon does not use ammo pickups; ammo regenerates over time. *Can use the Basmu-exclusive {{M|Dreadful Killshot}}. *Cannot equip {{M|Sinister Reach}} or {{M|Combustion Beam}}. {{Advantages| *Siphoning pulse gives crowd control and healing on emptying the weapon's charge. }} {{Disadvantages| *Low accuracy. *Primary Fire: **Explosion inflicts [[Stagger|self-stagger]]. **Explosion has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions. **Explosion has linear damage falloff from 100% to 80% from central impact. **Projectiles have travel time. *Alternate fire requires a damage ramp-up. *Small battery size in contrast to its fast fire rate. }} ==Acquisition== *Basmu's blueprint is obtainable from limited-time events: **Basmu was first introduced in [[Operation: Scarlet Spear]], purchasable from [[Little Duck]] for 15,000 {{Resource|Scarlet Credits}}. **[[Operation: Orphix Venom]] sold Basmu's blueprint from [[Father]] for 1,500 {{Resource|Phasic Cells}}. **The October 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026 [[Nights of Naberus]] sold and currently sell Basmu's blueprint from [[Daughter]] for 125 {{Resource|Mother Token|Mother Tokens}}. **The blueprint can be [[Trading|traded]] between players. **[[Operation: Gargoyle's Cry]] sold Basmu's blueprint from Vigil Jahu Gargoyle for 3 {{Resource|Grotesque Splinter}}. **[[Operation: Belly of the Beast]] sold Basmu's blueprint from [[Ordis]] for 15 {{Resource|Volatile Motes}}. Has a purchase limit of 1. **[[Operation: Eight Claw]] sold Basmu's blueprint from [[Dominus Thrax]] for 9 {{Resource|Dominus Aureus}}. Has a purchase limit of 1. **[[Operation: Blood of Perita]] sold Basmu's blueprint from [[Roathe]] for 20 {{Resource|Marks of Valiance}}. Has no purchase limit. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== * Initial hit and explosion of the primary fire apply status separately. ** Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. ** Explosion has linear damage falloff from 100% to 80% from central impact. * When fired at an enemy, the alternate fire will chain to the closest living enemy within '''7''' meters of the initial target. From there it will chain again, up to a maximum of '''5''' chains in total. A chain will do {{MathText|0.5{{exp|n}}}} times the main beam's damage, where '''n''' is the chain number. ** Enemy corpses will still allow the beam to connect to nearby enemies. ** Damage ramps up from 20% to 100% over 0.5 seconds when firing. After firing stops for 0.8 seconds, the damage decays back to 20% over 2 seconds. ** Consumes 1 ammo per damage tick instead of 0.5, unlike most other continuous weapons. ** Headshotting the original target does not affect the chain damage. ** The beam '''will not''' chain to a [[Nullifier Crewman|Nullifier]] through its shield should it connect with a target outside or partially enclosed by it. * Basmu has a '''2''' second reload animation from empty before ammo is restored to full; if there are still rounds left, there is a delay of '''0.2''' seconds after which it regenerates '''42''' ammo per second; it takes '''0.5''' seconds to regenerate a fully depleted battery excluding the delay. * Pulsing during the reload animation will only activate if the user is on the ground, and will terminate early if the user jumps, rolls or slides. ** Pulse has linear damage falloff from 100% to 0% from center. ** Pulse does not require line of sight. ** Pulse damage is affected by base damage mods (e.g. {{M|Serration}}, {{M|Heavy Caliber}}). ** Pulse area of effect is affected by ({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}) {{M|Firestorm}}. ** Decreasing reload speed (and thus increasing reload time) results in more pulses, while increasing reload speed results in fewer pulses. *** Increasing the reload by only 15% is enough to lose the third pulse. ** The pulse damage is not affected by Multishot mods, Elemental damage mods or abilities that function in a similar manner such as {{A|Nourish|}} or {{A|Shock}} when augmented with {{M|Shock Trooper}}. ** The pulse damage is affected by abilities that increase base damage, such as {{A|Roar}} and {{A|Vex Armor}}, and abilities that give a distinct extra hit to attacks like {{A|Xata's Whisper}}. ** The pulse damage is increased by {{D|Viral}} procs. == Known Bugs == * {{M|Galvanized Aptitude}} is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits from primary fire. ==Tips== *The Basmu reloads significantly faster when the magazine has not been emptied. **When not in the need of healing it is recommended to stop firing just before the magazine is empty to increase offensive capabilities. **Equipping a maxed {{M|Speed Trigger}} and a maxed {{M|Vile Acceleration}} and no mods that increase magazine size, and simply holding down the fire button to empty it as soon as reload completes, times properly with the pulses so that they fire at an endless constant rate. *There are several ways to make use of the alternate fire's high [[critical multiplier]] by adding flat [[critical chance]] bonuses: **An [[Adarza Kavat]] with {{M|Cat's {{A|Covenant}} can add up to +50% additive crit chance, or +200% on headshots, after absorbing enough damage. **A fully ranked {{Arcane|Arcane Avenger}} will grant a +45% flat critical chance buff when your frame is hit. **{{WF|Citrine}}'s {{A|Crystallize}} set critical chance to '''300%''' when hitting its crystal growths. *After emptying the magazine, {{WF|Garuda}} can channel {{A|Seeking Talons}} without disrupting the healing pulses. ==Trivia== *The ''[[wikipedia:Bašmu|Bašmu]]'' is an ancient Mesopotamian mythological creature, a horned snake with two forelegs and wings. *Shortly
